blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lawmaker pushing for a national framework on artificial intelligence (AI) wants a proposed agency overseeing the technology’s development placed under the Department of Science and Technology (DOST), saying the department is better equipped to drive research and innovation than the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT). FPJ Panday Bayanihan Rep. Brian Poe Llamanzares said the DICT already has its hands full overseeing telecommunications, social media data and other digital concerns, and should not be burdened with the additional responsibility of leading the country’s AI development. “I don’t want to bog down the DICT.
